name: kyber1024-keys-from-seed
description: Kyber pre-keys generated by the vector generator from seeds d and z, either with FIPS 203 ML-KEM-1024 KeyGen_internal(d, z) or with CRYSTALS-Kyber round-3 Kyber1024 key generation (d, then z). The oracle cannot generate keys from a seed, so these keys are not oracle outputs. Each key was loaded into an oracle responder, an oracle initiator encapsulated to it, and the oracle responder decrypted the resulting pre-key message. shared_secret is the round-3 decapsulation of oracle_ciphertext, confirmed through the oracle chain key. This shows the oracle accepts keys from either key generation; encapsulation and decapsulation must still be round 3.
